UNL-193.name: Gloomist
UNL-193.rules_text: When you or an ally hold, you may exhaust me to draw 1.

UNL-194.name: Shadow
UNL-194.rules_text: If you play me to a battlefield, I enter ready. [Action][>] 1 energy1 rune of any type, exhaust: [Stun] an enemy unit attacking here. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

UNL-195.name: Green Father
UNL-195.rules_text: When you conquer or hold, you may exhaust me to replace that battlefield with a Brush battlefield token. (Bird, Cat, Dog, Poro, and Ivern units have +1 might in Brush. It can be swapped back when scored.)

UNL-196.name: Daisy!
UNL-196.rules_text: I enter ready. Reduce my cost by 1 energy for each of the following tags among your units — Bird, Cat, Dog, and Poro. When I attack while your units have all 4 tags, [Stun] an enemy unit here. (It doesn't deal combat damage this turn.)

UNL-197.name: Scorn of the Moon
UNL-197.rules_text: [Reaction][>] exhaust: [Add] 1 energy. Spend this Energy only during showdowns. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

UNL-198.name: Moonfall
UNL-198.rules_text: [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Choose a battlefield where you have units. You may move up to one enemy unit to that battlefield. Then give enemy units there -2 might this turn.

UNL-199.name: Deceiver
UNL-199.rules_text: When you conquer or hold, you may discard 1 and exhaust me to play a ready Reflection unit token there. It becomes a copy of another unit there. Give it [Temporary].

UNL-200.rules_text: Choose a unit. Play a ready Reflection unit token to your base. It becomes a copy of that unit. Give it [Temporary]. (Kill it at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)

UNL-201.rules_text: When you win a combat, gain 1 XP. Spend 1 XP, exhaust: [Buff] a unit. Spend 2 XP, exhaust: Move an exhausted friendly unit from a battlefield to its base.

UNL-202.name: Void Assault
UNL-202.rules_text: Move a friendly unit, then move an enemy unit. (If they both move to a battlefield you don't control, you're the attacker.)

UNL-203.name: Keeper of the Hammer
UNL-203.rules_text: When you hold, gain 1 XP. Spend 3 XP, exhaust: Draw 1.

UNL-204.name: Keeper's Verdict
UNL-204.rules_text: [Action] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.) Choose an enemy unit at a battlefield. Its owner places it on the top or bottom of their Main Deck.

UNL-205.name: Abandoned Hall
UNL-205.rules_text: When a player plays a spell, they may give a unit they control here +1 might this turn.

UNL-206.name: Altar of Blood

UNL-208.name: Black Flame Altar
UNL-208.rules_text: Units here with [Temporary] have [Shield]. (+1 might while they're defenders.)

UNL-209.name: Dusk Rose Lab
UNL-209.rules_text: At the start of your Beginning Phase, you may kill a unit you control here to draw 1. (This happens before scoring.)

UNL-210.name: Forbidding Waste
UNL-210.rules_text: While a unit here is defending alone, it has -2 might. (It's alone if there are no other friendly units here.)

UNL-211.name: Forgotten Library
UNL-211.rules_text: While you control this battlefield, when you play a spell, if you spent 4 energy or more, [Predict]. (Look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

UNL-212.name: Frozen Fortress
UNL-212.rules_text: At the start of each player's Beginning Phase, deal 1 to each unit here. (This happens before scoring.)

UNL-214.name: Ripper's Bay
UNL-214.rules_text: When a unit here is returned to a player's hand, that player may pay 1 energy to channel 1 rune exhausted.

UNL-215.name: Star Spring
UNL-215.rules_text: The first time a player plays a non-token unit here each turn, they may move another unit they control here to its base.

UNL-216.name: The Academy
UNL-216.rules_text: When you hold here, give your next spell this turn [Repeat] equal to its base cost. (You may pay the additional cost to repeat the spell's effect.)

UNL-218.name: Valley of Idols

UNL-219.name: Vaults of Helia
